films.t: A Matter of Life and Death
films.rev: Classic, feel good, and fun - with fantastic set pieces. Unfortunately, I didn't find it overly dynamic and/or exciting.

"Uh... It was enjoyable" - Sgt Angle

Bonkers cast? Yes. Questionable song choice? Yes. Poorly aged style/aesthetic? Yeah, probably. It's often dangerously close to being ridiculous and terrible...

But in spite of all this, the core substance is obviously classic and very enjoyable, and it gets some points for boldness and creativity... and for sort of just having fun.
